package rulefixtures

import (
	gorm "gorm.io/gorm"
)

// scenario for nested_transaction_in_request_path: Multiple transactions started on a single request path.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: data_access; severity: contextual.
type Rule275PositiveRecord struct{ ID int }

func scenario275Positive(db *gorm.DB, userID int, orderID int) error {
	return db.Transaction(func(tx *gorm.DB) error {
		if err := tx.First(&Rule275PositiveRecord{}, userID).Error; err != nil {
			return err
		}
		return tx.Transaction(func(innerTx *gorm.DB) error {
			return innerTx.First(&Rule275PositiveRecord{}, orderID).Error
		})
	})
}
